result.instructions: Tools for GHTK, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What is the status of GHTK order a4 for my shop?"; "How much does it cost to ship a 2 kg parcel from Hà Nội to Đà Nẵng by road?"; "List my pickup addresses and the solutions my shop can attach to an order.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes GHTK data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run ghtk_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run ghtk_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run ghtk_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. ghtk_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: ghtk_list_pickup_addresses
tools.title: List pickup addresses
tools.description: List the pickup addresses saved in the shop, with their ids. Use an id as pick_address_id in ghtk_create_order. Token permission: not named in the GHTK docs; the token needs access to this call. Open API: GET /services/shipment/list_pick_add.

tools.name: ghtk_find_address
tools.title: Look up a level-4 address
tools.description: Check a delivery address against GHTK's address data (province, district, ward or street). Use it before ghtk_create_order to get the exact spelling GHTK expects. Token permission: not named in the GHTK docs; the token needs access to this call. Open API: GET /services/address/getAddressLevel4.

province.description: Province or city name, for example "Hà Nội".

address.description: Full level-4 address text, for example "Đội Cấn".

tools.name: ghtk_calculate_shipping_fee
tools.title: Calculate a shipping fee
tools.description: Get the shipping fee and insurance fee for a route and weight, before an order is created. Token permission: Calculate order fees. Open API: GET /services/shipment/fee.

weight_grams.description: Total weight of all items in grams (not kilograms).

value.description: Declared value in VND, the base for the insurance fee.

transport.description: Shipping method: road (by land) or fly (by air). If omitted, GHTK uses its default.

tools.name: ghtk_search_products
tools.title: Search warehouse products
tools.description: Search the shop's product list by name. Returns product codes you can pass as product_code in ghtk_create_order. Token permission: not named in the GHTK docs; the token needs access to this call. Open API: GET /services/kho-hang/thong-tin-san-pham.

term.description: Product name or keyword, for example "laptop".

tools.name: ghtk_list_solutions
tools.title: List GHTK solutions
tools.description: List the GHTK solutions (service add-ons) the shop can attach to an order, with their solution_id values. Token permission: not named in the GHTK docs; the token needs access to this call. Open API: GET /open/api/v1/shop/solution/list.

tools.name: ghtk_get_order_status
tools.title: Get order status
tools.description: Get the status, fees, pickup and delivery dates, and COD amount of one order. Pass the GHTK label (for example S1.A1.17373471) or your own order code. Token permission: Get order status. Open API: GET /services/shipment/v2/{TRACKING_ORDER}.

order_id.description: The GHTK label or your own order code (order_id sent at creation).

tools.name: ghtk_create_order
tools.title: Create a shipping order
tools.description: Create a real GHTK shipping order: GHTK schedules a pickup and charges the shipping fee. Re-sending the same order_id is refused by GHTK, so it does not create a second order. Give street or hamlet (use "Other" for hamlet when neither applies). Token permission: Create order. Open API: POST /services/shipment/order (JSON).

order_id.description: Your own order code. GHTK refuses an order_id it already has.

product_code.description: Product code from ghtk_search_products, if the product has one.

products.description: Items in the order. Weights are in kilograms.

pick_address_id.description: Pickup address id from ghtk_list_pickup_addresses. If set, GHTK uses it before the pickup fields.

street.description: Recipient street. Give this or hamlet.

hamlet.description: Recipient hamlet, village or cluster. Give this or street; "Other" if neither applies.

pick_money.description: Cash on delivery (COD) amount the courier collects, in VND. 0 = no COD.

value.description: Declared value in VND. The base for the insurance fee and compensation.

is_freeship.description: 1 = recipient pays only the COD amount; 0 = recipient pays COD plus the shipping fee (default 0).

transport.description: Shipping method: road (by land) or fly (by air). If omitted, GHTK uses its default.

tools.name: ghtk_cancel_order
tools.title: Cancel a shipping order
tools.description: Cancel an order that GHTK has not picked up yet. GHTK refuses a cancel after pickup. Pass the GHTK label, or set id_type to partner_order_id to pass your own order code. Token permission: not named in the GHTK docs; the token needs access to order cancellation. Open API: POST /services/shipment/cancel/{TRACKING_ORDER}.

order_id.description: The GHTK label (for example S1.A1.17373471) or your own order code.

id_type.description: What order_id holds: ghtk_label (default) or partner_order_id (your own order code).
